instruction: I want to make all text in my presentation more readable by changing the font size to 24 points. Is there a way to do this globally without manually adjusting each text box?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all font sizes in a 28-slide presentation to 24 points. Evaluator extracts all unique font sizes and verifies only 24pt is present.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Getter correctly iterates through all slides, shapes, text frames, paragraphs, and runs to extract all font sizes in the presentation
Correct verification logic: Metric checks that only 24pt font size exists by comparing result set to {24.0}, which properly verifies global font size change
Semantic correctness: Evaluator correctly interprets 'change all text to 24 points globally' as requiring that ONLY 24pt font size exists in the entire presentation
Proper data flow: Getter extracts all unique font sizes → Metric verifies only 24.0 is present → Returns 1.0 for success, 0.0 for failure
Adequate postconfig: Saves file with Ctrl+S before verification, ensuring getter reads the updated file state
Edge case handling: Getter checks if run.font.size exists before accessing, preventing None errors
